data.one_liner: A stepped slider implementation using radio buttons for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a stepped slider widget that uses radio buttons to represent the available steps. It supports null safety and works across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need a stepped slider ui combined with radio buttons
You are building a form that requires discrete step selection using radio buttons
avoid_when: You need a standard continuous slider without radio buttons
You require complex custom form validation beyond what the widget offers
strengths: Combines stepped sliders and radio buttons into a single component
Supports null safety and the v2 Flutter embedding
weaknesses: Very minimal documentation and example coverage in the README
Limited feature set beyond the basic radio button slider implementation
